definitions.explanation: To apply or enter for something, such as a job or contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{応募|おうぼ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{応募|おうぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The application deadline is next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

notes:
{応募|おうぼ} is a noun/suru-verb meaning to apply or enter (for jobs, contests, etc.).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {応募|おうぼ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to apply)
- {応募|おうぼ}⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧ (application deadline)
- {応募|おうぼ}⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧ (application form)
- {応募|おうぼ}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (eligibility requirements)
- ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧ (applicant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {応募|おうぼ}: applying for jobs, contests, programs
- ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧: general application/registration
